Actual composed art-cutout face for [[Major Caluan Ematt (Errata)]] from page 2 of [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-October-2021-capture.pdf]], known by the 5 October 2021 archive capture. The upper title, destiny and lower stats/text remain; the central artwork area is absent in the published source. Nothing is filled or reconstructed. Original PDF coordinates [214.0, 299.5, 393.0, 541.0]; render matrix 745 divided by clip width, alpha=False. The original whole PDF and embedded page raster are preserved. [[Category:Card images]]
